definitions: The assembled spectators or listeners at a public event, such as a play, movie, concert, or meeting.
The readership of a book, magazine, or newspaper, or the viewership of a television program.
A formal interview with a person in authority.
A group of people who participate in a show or event, often by clapping, cheering, or answering questions.
examples: The show attracted a large audience.
He was granted an audience with the Pope.
The comedian interacted with the audience.
